metric_policy.money_representation: Exact Decimal strings, no per-line or aggregate rounding
metric_policy.included_rows: Finite positive unit price and nonzero integer quantity; signed amounts retained
metric_policy.excluded_rows: Missing/invalid/nonpositive price or missing/invalid/zero quantity; retain rows and explicit exclusion reason
metric_policy.gross_positive_value: Sum quantity * unit_price where included quantity is positive
metric_policy.negative_value_magnitude: Absolute sum quantity * unit_price where included quantity is negative
metric_policy.net_transaction_value: gross_positive_value minus negative_value_magnitude; not recognized revenue, profit or cash flow
metric_policy.cancellation: Invoice starts with C, case insensitive; report separately from quantity sign
